validator.source_text:
<scxml xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2005/07/scxml" version="1.0" datamodel="ecmascript" initial="a">
  <datamodel>
    <data id="count" expr="0"/>
    <data id="done" expr="false"/>
    <data id="user" expr="({name:'bob'})"/>
  </datamodel>
  <state id="a">
    <onentry><raise name="go"/></onentry>
    <transition event="go" target="b"/>
  </state>
  <final id="b"/>
</scxml>

diagnostics.message: `<raise>` requires `event` but has `name`, which it does not accept
notes: the W3C SCXML 1.0 schema rejects this under XML Schema constraint `cvc-complex-type.3.2.2`: Attribute 'name' is not allowed for this element
diagnostics.help: did you mean `event="go"`? rename `name` to `event` to keep the value
spec_references: XML Schema 1.0 Part 1 §3.4.4 Element Locally Valid (Complex Type) (`cvc-complex-type.3.2.2`)
